## Introduction Opening reading, Psalm 30: I will extol thee, O Lord, for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me. Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning. Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing. Opening prayer: Heavenly Father, the God of our father Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, we thank you for another Sabbath and for a place where we can come together in fellowship. We pray for those who are sick in the midst of us, and for every brother that is traveling for Passover; be with these men and protect them. The work is great and we still have a long way to go; send more laborers. Watch over the bishops, the deacons, the captains and the officers you have put on the forefront to wake up thy people. As we see the prophecies coming to pass day by day, help us to prepare mentally, spiritually and physically for what is coming; no man can prepare fully, but if we put our trust in thee we can overcome. We pray for our brothers and sisters scattered to the four corners of the earth who die every day under the hand of the enemy, especially our people in the Sudan, the forgotten ones the media has a blackout on, and for our people in Palestine and Iran. Have mercy on thy people in these last days, and let the enemy be used to destroy each other for what they did to thy people. As for us, we ask for mercy and compassion; be patient with us. Let all Israel say hallelujah. Today's lesson is entitled America, the New Roman Empire. Get out your pens and papers and take notes. Thumbnail video: a mock news bulletin. The US, Israel and Iran have come to an agreement, a ceasefire for the next two weeks. Reporting live, the tension between Iran and the US is now escalating. Then a Latin declaration and the caption: it is time for Rome to perish. Shout out to the ad department; you brothers and sisters are on fire. ## Scriptures Opened **[Romans 15:4](/bible/romans/15#v4)** *[[21:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZnReLwFHcS8&t=1311s)]* > [4](/bible/romans/15#v4) For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope. - We open with this because it says the same thing Ecclesiastes 1:9 said last week: there is no new thing under the sun. Whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope. So it behooves us to read, read, and read more. Everything America does is written already; we are going to show you the pattern in Rome.

**[2 Esdras 11:1-6](/bible/2-esdras/11#v1)** *[[25:21](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZnReLwFHcS8&t=1521s)]* > [1](/bible/2-esdras/11#v1) Then saw I a dream, and, behold, there came up from the sea an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads. > > [2](/bible/2-esdras/11#v2) And I saw, and, behold, she spread her wings over all the earth, and all the winds of the air blew on her, and were gathered together. > > [3](/bible/2-esdras/11#v3) And I beheld, and out of her feathers there grew other contrary feathers; and they became little feathers and small. > > [4](/bible/2-esdras/11#v4) But her heads were at rest: the head in the midst was greater than the other, yet rested it with the residue. > > [5](/bible/2-esdras/11#v5) Moreover I beheld, and, lo, the eagle flew with her feathers, and reigned upon earth, and over them that dwelt therein. > > [6](/bible/2-esdras/11#v6) And I saw that all things under heaven were subject unto her, and no man spake against her, no, not one creature upon earth. - Ezra saw a dream: an eagle came up from the sea with twelve feathered wings and three heads. She spread her wings over all the earth, and all the winds of the air blew on her. Out of her feathers grew other contrary feathers, little and small, but her heads were at rest, and the head in the midst was greater than the others. - The eagle flew with her feathers and reigned upon the earth, and all things under heaven were subject unto her; no man spake against her, not one creature upon earth could come against this eagle. It was so powerful. This is the fourth empire. **[2 Esdras 12:10-11](/bible/2-esdras/12#v10)** *[[26:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZnReLwFHcS8&t=1605s)]* > [10](/bible/2-esdras/12#v10) And he said unto me, This is the interpretation of the vision: > > [11](/bible/2-esdras/12#v11) The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel. - Listen good: 2 Esdras 11 is answered in 2 Esdras 12. The two chapters go together; chapter 11 is the vision, chapter 12 is the interpretation. The eagle that came up from the sea is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of Daniel, but it was not expounded unto him. So let us read Daniel 7 and see what Daniel saw that was never explained to him. **[Daniel 7:3-7](/bible/daniel/7#v3)** *[[27:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZnReLwFHcS8&t=1648s)]* > [3](/bible/daniel/7#v3) And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another. > > [5](/bible/daniel/7#v5) And behold another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it: and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh. > > [6](/bible/daniel/7#v6) After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it. > > [7](/bible/daniel/7#v7) After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns. - Four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another. The first was like a lion with eagle's wings: that is the Babylonian Empire. The second, like a bear raised up on one side with three ribs in its mouth: that is the Medo-Persian Empire, first called Medo-Persian and later Persia-Media because the Persians became greater than the Medes; the three ribs were Egypt, Ethiopia and Sheba. - The third, like a leopard with four wings of a fowl and four heads: that is the Greeks. The four wings are the four major armies of Alexander's four generals, and the four heads are the generals who divided the kingdom: Lysimachus, Ptolemy, Cassander and Seleucus. - Then the fourth beast, dreadful and terrible and strong exceedingly, with great iron teeth; it devoured and brake in pieces and stamped the residue with its feet, diverse from all the beasts before it, and it had ten horns. Notice it does not give you an animal symbol for the fourth beast the way it gave the lion, the bear and the leopard. Daniel never understood that the fourth kingdom would be represented by the eagle; the Most High declared that to Ezra. **[2 Esdras 12:14-15](/bible/2-esdras/12#v14)** *[[30:54](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZnReLwFHcS8&t=1854s)]* > [14](/bible/2-esdras/12#v14) In the same shall twelve kings reign, one after another: > > [15](/bible/2-esdras/12#v15) Whereof the second shall begin to reign, and shall have more time than any of the twelve. - In the same shall twelve kings reign, one after another; the twelve wings, or feathers, are twelve kings. Whereof the second shall begin to reign and shall have more time than any of the twelve: that is Augustus Caesar, who reigned the longest. We are going to go through them slowly.

The next following stood up and reigned and had a great time: Augustus. - Then came a voice: Hear thou that hast borne rule over the earth so long, before thou beginnest to appear no more, there shall none after thee attain unto thy time, neither unto the half thereof. No Caesar after Augustus would reign as long as his 41 years. - Then arose the third and reigned as the other before, and appeared no more also: Tiberius. So went it with all the residue one after another: every one reigned and then appeared no more. There were twelve in total.
